snippet.title: David and Goliath for Kids | Bible Story Cartoon with Quiz (1 Samuel 17)
snippet.description:
David and Goliath for kids, the whole Bible story from 1 Samuel 17 in a fun cartoon. Meet a shepherd boy who fought a lion and a bear, count the five smooth stones with us, and watch the giant fall. Stay to the end for a quick quiz!

"You come to me using a sword, a large spear, and a small spear. But I come to you in the name of the Lord of heaven's armies. He's the God of the armies of Israel! You have spoken out against him." 1 Samuel 17:45 (ICB)

Great for Sunday school, family devotions and bedtime Bible stories for kids ages 4 to 12.

Like it and send it to a family who would enjoy it.
